Definition: to loosen, i.e. relinquish, permit, etc.
BiblicalUsage: 1) to leave, loose, forsake; 1a) (Qal) to leave; 1a1) to depart from, leave behind, leave, let alone; 1a2) to leave, abandon, forsake, neglect, apostatise; 1a3) to let loose, set free, let go, free; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be left to; 1b2) to be forsaken; 1c) (Pual) to be deserted; 2) to restore, repair; 2a) (Qal) to repair
